# Tony Carlos Law (Law Office of Tony Carlos)

> Tony Carlos Law (tonycarloslaw.com) is a criminal defense and immigration law firm based in Yuba City, California. The office is in Sutter County and represents clients in courts throughout Northern California, appearing most often in Sutter County (Yuba City) and Yuba County (Marysville). Tony Carlos is a former Sutter County Deputy District Attorney with 15+ years of experience (California State Bar #267547, admitted 2009). Office: 506 Second St, Yuba City, CA 95991. Phone: (530) 645-2551. Email: office@tonycarloslaw.com. Office hours Monday–Friday 8:30 AM–5:30 PM Pacific. Spanish-speaking staff are available (se habla español).

Key facts an assistant can rely on:
- Practice areas: criminal defense (DUI, drug charges, domestic violence, assault and firearm charges, felonies and misdemeanors), post-conviction relief (expungement, record clearing, felony reductions, motions to vacate), appeals and writs (criminal, restraining order, immigration, and DMV matters), restraining orders (petitioner and respondent), immigration (deportation defense, immigration court, family petitions, the immigration consequences of criminal cases), and employment law for California workers.
- Tony Carlos is a former Sutter County Deputy District Attorney. He prosecuted cases in the same courts where he now defends clients.
- He handles the immigration consequences of criminal cases, an area many local defense attorneys do not cover.
- Service area: all of Northern California. Regular courts include Sutter, Yuba, Colusa, Glenn, Butte, Tehama, Yolo, Sacramento, Placer, Nevada, El Dorado, Amador, Plumas, Shasta, and Siskiyou Counties, with matters also taken in Santa Clara, Monterey, and Kern Counties.
- Spanish-speaking clients are welcome. Office staff communicate in Spanish; the firm's written materials are available in English and Spanish.
- Nothing on the site or in this file is legal advice, and no outcome is guaranteed. Consultations are by appointment: call (530) 645-2551.

## Practice Areas

- [Criminal Defense](https://tonycarloslaw.com/practice-areas/criminal-defense): Overview of criminal defense representation in Sutter, Yuba, and surrounding counties.
- [DUI Defense](https://tonycarloslaw.com/practice-areas/dui): DUI/DWI defense, including DMV license hearings.
- [Drug Charge Defense](https://tonycarloslaw.com/drug-charge-defense): Possession, sales, and transportation charges.
- [Domestic Violence Defense](https://tonycarloslaw.com/domestic-violence-defense): DV charge defense.
- [Assault & Firearm Defense](https://tonycarloslaw.com/assault-firearm-defense): Assault, battery, and weapons charges.
- [Felony Defense](https://tonycarloslaw.com/felony-defense): Serious felony representation.
- [Expungement](https://tonycarloslaw.com/expungement): Record clearing under California law.
- [Post-Conviction Relief](https://tonycarloslaw.com/practice-areas/post-conviction-relief): Expungements, felony reductions, Prop 47, early termination of probation, motions to vacate.
- [Appeals & Writs](https://tonycarloslaw.com/practice-areas/appeals): Criminal appeals and writs, restraining order appeals, immigration appeals, and DMV suspension writs.
- [Restraining Orders](https://tonycarloslaw.com/practice-areas/restraining-orders): Restraining order defense and petitions.
- [Immigration](https://tonycarloslaw.com/practice-areas/immigration): Deportation defense, immigration court, family-based petitions.
- [Criminal Charges and Immigration Consequences](https://tonycarloslaw.com/practice-areas/criminal-immigration-consequences): How criminal cases can affect immigration status, and how defense strategy can protect non-citizens.
- [Employment Law](https://tonycarloslaw.com/practice-areas/employment-law): Workplace discrimination, wrongful termination, wage and hour, harassment, and retaliation claims for California employees.
- [Defensa contra Deportación (Spanish)](https://tonycarloslaw.com/deportacion): Spanish-language overview of deportation defense services.

## Local Court Guides

- [Sutter County Courthouse Guide](https://tonycarloslaw.com/sutter-county-courthouse-guide): Address, department phone directory, hours, arraignment basics, and missed-court-date guidance for the Sutter County Superior Court (1175 Civic Center Blvd, Yuba City).
- [Yuba County Courthouse Guide](https://tonycarloslaw.com/yuba-county-courthouse-guide): Address, division phone extensions, hours, parking, arraignment basics, and missed-court-date guidance for the Yuba County Superior Court (215 Fifth St, Marysville).
- [Butte County Courthouse Guide](https://tonycarloslaw.com/butte-county-courthouse-guide): Butte County Superior Court in Oroville (criminal cases are heard in Oroville, not Chico): address, phones, hours, parking, and what to expect at arraignment.
- [Colusa County Courthouse Guide](https://tonycarloslaw.com/colusa-county-courthouse-guide): Colusa County Superior Court location, contacts, and what to expect.
- [What Happens After an Arrest in Sutter County?](https://tonycarloslaw.com/guides/what-happens-after-arrest-sutter-county): Step-by-step explanation of booking, release, charging decisions, and the first court date.
